notes: Re-derived 2026-10-10 from the 85%-strength AI reference block 85AI1_s2_pair1_adaptive_20261010_125726, superseding the 2026-09-08 version that was derived from the 100% AI. Only the BRAKING zones and the pass brackets that bound them moved; apex gates, apex windows and corner-speed windows are untouched. WHY: no element ever faded in any human block, and the braking criterion was the worst of the three (one pass in ten clearing accuracy). The 100% AI brakes 22-27 m later than the 85% AI at corners 1-3, so an 85% reference is under review as the target; the zones are anchored on the 85% brake points because those are the EARLIEST of the three candidates (100/85/80%), which makes one set of zones fit whichever reference is finally committed. HOW: a braking zone must contain the learner's brake initiation, early or late, or the criterion yields null and the corner silently leaves the braking element's evidence. Room is therefore budgeted in SECONDS at the approach speed, not in metres: target 1.5 s before the reference brake point and 1.0 s after it. Approach speeds at the 85% brake points are 197, 191, 199 and 114 km/h, which is why corner 4's 48 m buys more early-braking room than corner 1's 67 m. Measured against 155 real human passes, brake points ran 28 m early to 46 m late of the 85% reference, so the new zones hold roughly 2-3x the worst observed excursion in both directions. LIMITS, both geometric and worth stating: corner 1 (Copse) brakes only 92 m after the start/finish line, so its zone cannot reach 1.5 s back without wrapping the line - and a wrapping bracket would attribute the pass to the previous lap. It gets 1.22 s (67 m), the most the layout allows. Corner 4 is bounded by corner 3's pass bracket; corner 3's exit gate moved from 0.6970 to 0.6945 to free 13 m for it, which leaves 2.4 m between corner 3's 15 m apex window and its exit gate. Corner 4 reaches 1.50 s (48 m). Also 2026-10-10: braking.end was extended at corners 1 and 4, which had only 5.7 m and 28 m of zone beyond the latest observed brake point - the mirror of the fault the 2026-09-08 re-derivation fixed on the early side, and unflagged until the extractor's zone-fit check learned to look both ways. Corner 1's braking zone now overlaps its corner-speed window by 1.4 m, which is legal and expected (trail braking); the two chains are checked independently.
